common.offlineBody: You can view your saved CVs. Changes and downloads need a connection.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.bad_request: Something in that request wasn't right. Please check and try again.
errors.rate_limited: That's a lot of requests in a short time. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.too_large: That file or text is too large. The limit is 5 MB, or about 25 pages of text.
errors.unsupported_type: We can read PDF, Word (.docx) and plain text files.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read that file. If it's a scanned PDF, try pasting the text instead.
errors.empty: We didn't find any text. If it's a scanned PDF, try pasting the text instead.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI reader is busy right now. Try again, or switch off AI to use the basic reader.
errors.ai_refused: The AI reader couldn't process this. Switch off AI to use the basic reader.
errors.ai_invalid: The AI reader returned something we couldn't use. Try again, or switch off AI.
errors.unsupported_characters: The PDF can't show some characters yet ({chars}). Download the Word version instead; it supports every script.
errors.not_configured: This feature isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.missing_inputs: Fill in the details this kind of email needs first.
errors.ai_required: "Another take" needs the AI writer. Switch on AI, or edit the paragraph yourself.

landing.title: A clear CV and a short email, built from what you've really done.
landing.lead: Paste a job, and get a CV and application email in your own words, formatted the way employers expect where you're applying.

truth.title: Nothing invented
truth.body: Every line comes from facts you entered or confirmed. If a job asks for something you haven't shown, we ask you instead of guessing.

region.title: Right for the country
region.body: Photo or no photo, date of birth, page length, paper size and spelling adjust to where you're applying. You can change any of it.

private.title: Your data stays yours
private.body: Never sold, never shared, never used to train AI. Export or delete everything whenever you like.

welcome.title: Let's get you set up
welcome.lead: Sign in to keep your CVs safe across devices, or try it first without an account.
welcome.upgradeTitle: Save your work to an account
welcome.upgradeLead: Sign in and we'll move what's on this device into your account.
welcome.needConsent: Please tick the box to agree to how we store your details.
welcome.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
welcome.guestHint: Your data stays in this browser only. You can save it to an account later.
welcome.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't set up on this server yet. You can still use guest mode.
welcome.errorSend: We couldn't start sign-in. Please try again.
welcome.errorAuth: That sign-in link didn't work. It may have expired; please request a new one.

finish.migrateBody: This device has CVs and facts you made as a guest. Move them into this account, or delete them from this device.

region.upToPages: Up to {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
region.vary: Conventions vary by employer. You can override any field.
region.bannerDetected: Looks like you're in {country}. CV style set to {region}.
region.bannerSet: Applying in {country}. CV style set to {region}.

onboarding.detected: We guessed {country} from your connection. Change it if that's wrong.
onboarding.targetLead: Your CV's format follows where you're applying. You can change this for each CV.
onboarding.targetHint: Pick the main one. You can set a different country on each CV.
onboarding.voiceLead: Optional. Paste a few sentences you wrote, like an email or a message. We measure your style so your emails sound like you.
onboarding.voiceHint: Measured on your device. We keep the measurements, not the text.
onboarding.voiceSummary: About {words} words per sentence, {formality} tone, contractions: {contractions}.
onboarding.voiceMore: Add a few more sentences so we can read your style.
onboarding.startLead: Import a CV you already have and confirm each line, or add your facts from scratch.

home.jdComing: Paste the job, pick a CV, and get a short email built only from your facts, ready to send from your own email app.
home.stepFacts: Add your contact details and at least one role
home.jdNeedsCv: Build a CV first; the email is written from it.

apply.title: Apply
apply.subtitle: Paste a job and get a short email in your own words, built from your facts.
apply.noCv: You'll need a CV first. The email is built from it.
apply.phase2Title: Tailoring your CV to each job is coming next
apply.phase2Body: For now, the email is written from the CV you pick. Soon you'll be able to match a CV to the job, answer gap questions and approve each change.
apply.empty: Nothing here yet. Start an application to write your first email.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.subtitle: Keep track of where you've applied.
tracker.comingBody: A simple board for saved, applied, interview and offer, with gentle reminders to follow up. Reminders by email or WhatsApp will only ever be sent if you switch them on.

vault.title: Your CVs
vault.subtitle: Every CV is built from your confirmed facts.
vault.unconfirmed: {count, plural, one {# fact needs} other {# facts need}} confirming before it can appear on a CV.
vault.emptyWithFacts: Create one from your facts with "New CV".
vault.emptyNoFacts: Import a CV or add your facts first, then create a CV.
vault.deleteBody: This removes the CV and its saved versions. Your facts stay.

facts.title: Your facts
facts.subtitle: Everything your CVs say comes from here. Nothing else gets added.
facts.unconfirmedNote: {count, plural, one {# item from your import isn't} other {# items from your import aren't}} confirmed yet. Unconfirmed items never appear on a CV.
facts.addContact: Add your name and contact details
facts.unlinkedBody: These lines won't show on a CV until you link them to a role. Tap one to choose its role.

form.invalid: Please check the fields above. Some are missing or too long.
form.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
form.headline: Headline (optional)
form.headlineHint: A short line under your name, in your words. For example: Facilities manager, 8 years in residential.
form.linksHint: One per line, e.g. your LinkedIn or portfolio.
form.personalHint: Only shown where your CV's region expects them. You can switch each one on or off per CV.
form.visaHint: For example: UK Skilled Worker visa, or Australian citizen.
form.bulletHint: One thing per line, in your words. Add a number only if you know it.
form.skillHint: One skill, as you'd say it.

import.title: Import your CV
import.subtitle: We'll read it and suggest facts. You confirm each one before anything is saved.
import.fileHint: PDF, Word (.docx) or text, up to 5 MB. The file is read on your device and never uploaded; only its text is sent.
import.aiHint: More accurate. The text goes to our AI provider (Anthropic) to be read and is not used to train models. Switch off to use the basic reader.
import.readingLong: This can take up to a minute for long CVs.
import.reviewSubtitle: Confirm, edit or remove each item. Nothing is added to your facts until you save.
import.methodAi: Read with AI. It copies your wording, but please check every line.
import.methodBasic: Read with the basic reader. It's simpler, so check carefully and add anything it missed.
import.unverifiedNote: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} didn't match your CV's wording. They're marked below; check them carefully.
import.unverified: We couldn't find this wording in your CV. Check it.
import.contactReplace: You already have contact details. Confirming these will replace them.
import.useSummary: Use this as the summary on my CV
import.attentionLead: We couldn't place these lines. Add them as facts, or mark them as not needed. Lines you leave won't be saved.
import.pendingNote: {count, plural, one {# item isn't} other {# items aren't}} confirmed yet. They'll be saved as unconfirmed and won't appear on CVs until you confirm them.
import.attentionNote: {count, plural, one {# line still needs} other {# lines still need}} your attention and won't be saved.

builder.notFound: We couldn't find that CV. It may have been deleted.
builder.tooLong: This runs to {pages} pages; the {region} norm is up to {max}.
builder.hiddenFacts: Some facts aren't showing: {unconfirmed} unconfirmed, {unlinked} not linked to a role.
builder.tapToEdit: Tap any line to edit it for this CV.
builder.emptyPreview: Your CV will appear here once you add your contact details and some experience.
builder.summaryHint: Two or three sentences in your own words. Keep to facts you've confirmed.
builder.lineHint: Changes here apply to this CV only. Your fact stays as it is, unless you choose "Update the fact".
builder.showHidden: Show {count, plural, one {# hidden item} other {# hidden items}}
builder.applyingToHint: Sets the CV style. Changing it resets section order and personal-detail switches to that region's defaults.
builder.personalHint: Switch on only what you want to share. Defaults follow the region.
builder.atsLead: A quick check that hiring software can read your CV. It doesn't score how good you are.
builder.historyHint: We keep your last 10 versions. Versions are also saved automatically every few minutes while you edit.

me.title: Me
me.guestBody: You're using guest mode. Everything is stored in this browser only.
me.leaveGuestHint: Your data stays on this device until you delete it below.
me.targetHint: The default for new CVs. Each CV can have its own.
me.voiceNone: No sample yet. Adding one helps your emails sound like you.
me.voiceHint: A few sentences you wrote. Measured on your device; we keep the measurements, not the text.
me.privacyPromise: Your data is never sold, shared or used to train AI models.
me.coreGiven: You agreed to us storing your details on {date}. To withdraw this, delete your account below.
me.exportBody: Download everything as a ZIP: your data as JSON, plus each CV as a Word file.
me.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account, facts, CVs, versions and files. This can't be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
me.deleteGuestTitle: Delete my data from this device
me.deleteGuestBody: Permanently deletes your guest facts and CVs from this browser. This can't be undone.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page isn't available without a connection. Your saved CVs are still viewable.

compose.notFound: We couldn't find that application. It may have been deleted.
compose.jdHint: Paste the whole thing. We use it only to pick which of your facts fit. Nothing from it is claimed as your experience.
compose.clipboardBlocked: Your browser didn't allow reading the clipboard. Long-press the box and paste instead.
compose.cvHint: The email only uses facts that are on this CV, in this CV's wording.
compose.noCv: You'll need a CV first. The email is built from it.

apply_direct.label: Apply directly
apply_direct.hint: A short first email with your CV.

referral.label: Referral
referral.hint: Someone suggested you get in touch.

follow_up.label: Follow up (no reply yet)
follow_up.hint: A polite check-in, usually after about a week.

after_interview.label: Follow up after an interview
after_interview.hint: Ask about next steps and timing.

thank_you.label: Thank-you note
thank_you.hint: Thanks for their time after an interview or call.

accept_offer.label: Accept an offer
accept_offer.hint: Say yes clearly and ask what's next.

decline_offer.label: Decline an offer
decline_offer.hint: Say no kindly and keep the door open.

compose.recipientNameHint: Only if you know it. Without a name we use a neutral greeting; we never guess one.
compose.source: How did you find the role? (optional)
compose.sourceHint: For example: LinkedIn, the company's careers page, a careers fair.
compose.referrerHint: Their name, as you'd say it to the recipient.
compose.companyDetail: Something specific you know about the company (optional)
compose.companyDetailHint: Only something true that you actually know. We never make up details about the company.
compose.interviewDetailHint: A topic you discussed or something you'd like to add. In your own words.
compose.dateHint: Write it as you'd say it, e.g. 3 November.
compose.reasonHint: Only if you want to give one, e.g. you've accepted another role.
compose.aiHint: Writes from your facts in your style. The facts and job text go to our AI provider (Anthropic), which doesn't train on them. Switch off for a plain template that quotes your facts word for word.
compose.missing: Fill in the required detail above for this kind of email.
compose.offline: Writing an email needs a connection.
compose.madeAi: Written from your facts by AI. Check every line; you have the final say.
compose.madeBasic: Built from a plain template with your facts quoted word for word.
compose.regenerated: The first draft had problems, so it was rewritten once. Anything still flagged is marked below.
compose.tapToEdit: Tap any paragraph to edit it.
compose.anotherTakeAi: "Another take" is available when AI is on. You can always edit any paragraph yourself.
compose.lintFlags: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to check{errors, plural, =0 {} one { (# to fix)} other { (# to fix)}}. Tap a paragraph to change it.
compose.sendTitle: Send it from your own email
compose.sendLead: We don't send email for you. Open it in your email app, or copy it.
compose.attachReminder: Attach your CV (PDF) before you hit send
compose.attachWhy: Email links can't carry attachments, so add the file in your email app.
compose.longMailto: This email is long; some email apps cut off long links. If it looks incomplete, copy it instead.
compose.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
compose.emlHint: Opens as a draft in Outlook or Apple Mail, where you can attach your CV.
compose.noName: Your CV has no confirmed name yet, so the email can't be signed. Confirm your contact details first.
compose.unconfirmed: {count, plural, one {# fact isn't} other {# facts aren't}} confirmed yet, so the email can't use {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.

rules.bullet_parallelism: Every line follows the same pattern
